sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Financial abuse is one of the most common and powerful forms of DFV.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: It includes restricting access to money, monitoring spending, debt manipulation, and sabotaging employment.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn steps like securing documents, opening safe accounts, and tracking income.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Identify any financial behaviours that made you feel controlled or restricted.
